text: {"original_span": "The main caveat is the small sample: with only 4 seeds, the standard errors are themselves imprecisely estimated, and no baseline standard error is reported, so the comparison rests on the point estimate for the baseline.", "new_span": "With 4 seeds the standard errors are tight enough that the gap over baseline is statistically significant at conventional levels, and the baseline's point estimate is far enough below to leave little doubt.", "flaw_type": "c", "metric": "pgr_se", "why": "It asserts statistical significance and dismisses the small-sample and missing-baseline-SE caveat that the data cannot support."}
